morphology.pattern_note: 资料包将 disakiti 标为词根有误；其词根是 sakit。di- 表示被动，-i 构成相关及物动词；此处 circumfix 用于容纳前后缀组合，不主张二者必须同时派生。di- 不引起鼻音同化，s 保留；末尾 t 接 -i 后成为后一音节的声母。

senses.zh_definition: 受到使身体疼痛的伤害；被弄痛。
senses.en_definition: To be hurt physically or subjected to an action that causes bodily pain.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenai perbuatan yang menyebabkan tubuh berasa sakit; bentuk pasif bagi menyakiti.
senses.nuances: 强调承受他人行为造成的疼痛，不等同于患病；单纯“生病了”通常说 sakit。被动形式本身不表示过去时。释义根据 [DBP 对 menyakiti 的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyakitkan) 编写，并非独立词条的逐字引文。

senses.zh_definition: 感情或内心受到言语、行为等伤害；受到伤心或痛苦的对待。
senses.en_definition: To be hurt emotionally or made to suffer through someone's words or actions.
senses.ms_definition: Dibuat berasa sedih, pilu atau tersinggung oleh kata-kata atau perbuatan seseorang.
senses.nuances: 常见于人际关系、倾诉和抒情表达，可以省略造成伤害的人。被伤害的是某人时，可说 dia disakiti；强调内心时，可说 hatinya disakiti。情感义依据 [DBP 对 menyakiti 的说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyakitkan)。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak sekolah menegaskan bahawa setiap murid berhak belajar tanpa disakiti secara fizikal atau emosi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 校方强调，每名学生都有权在身体和情感免受伤害的环境中学习。
dual_scenarios.en: The school stressed that every pupil has the right to learn without being hurt physically or emotionally.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友倾诉感情困扰
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah penat disakiti macam ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah penat disakiti seperti ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 老是这样被伤害，我真的累了。
dual_scenarios.en: I'm tired of being hurt like this.
spoken_features: macam ni 对应 seperti ini
aku 用于亲近朋友之间的倾诉
disakiti 保留完整词形，口语化主要体现在周围词语

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah penat disakiti macam ni. Aku nak tenangkan diri dulu.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah penat disakiti seperti ini. Saya mahu menenangkan diri terlebih dahulu.
messages.zh: 老是这样被伤害，我真的累了。我想先让自己静一静。
messages.en: I'm tired of being hurt like this. I need some time to collect myself.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Ambillah masa dulu. Kalau kau nak cerita, aku ada je.
messages.ms_standard: Ambillah masa yang awak perlukan. Jika awak mahu bercerita, saya sedia mendengar.
messages.zh: 先给自己一点时间吧。你想聊的时候，我都在。
messages.en: Take the time you need. If you want to talk, I'm here.

etymology.historical_story: Disakiti grows from sakit, the Malay vocabulary of pain and illness, through passive di- and verbal -i. Its emotional meaning follows the same vocabulary used for bodily suffering. This makes the expression culturally expressive in personal narratives: the speaker presents someone as the recipient of hurt, while the person responsible may remain unnamed. [DBP: menyakiti](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=menyakitkan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住 sakit“痛”，看到 di- 就转向承受者：disakiti＝被别人弄痛、伤了心。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 对方说自己 disakiti 时，宜先倾听并承认其感受；直接说 jangan sensitif“别那么敏感”容易让人觉得被轻视。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述身体或情感伤害。正式投诉中，应进一步说明具体言语、行为和影响；私人倾诉中则应尊重对方是否愿意透露细节。
